events.title: Discussion on Draft Electricity (Amendment) Bill, 2025
events.description: Join stakeholders, regulators, and policymakers for an in-depth discussion on the Draft Electricity (Amendment) Bill, 2025. Explore key provisions, implications for the power sector, and opportunities to shape India's electricity regulatory framework.

events.fullDescription: The 26th RPR seeks to unpack the complex challenges and opportunities shaping India's ongoing energy transition. Through deliberations with key stakeholders, the Retreat will explore how the country can build a resilient, inclusive, and forward-looking energy strategy amid global geopolitical shifts, climate change, and market dynamics.
events.theme: The Evolving Power Sector: Navigating Geopolitics, Markets & India's Energy Transition
events.conceptNote: The past year has witnessed tectonic shifts in the global order, marked by a series of flashpoints that threaten peace and stability on one hand, and unforeseen geopolitical realignments and alliances on the other. From the spiraling conflict in the Middle East to heightened tensions between nuclear powers India and Pakistan, the protracted Russia-Ukraine war, and resurgence of dormant border disputes, the global landscape is undergoing profound transformation. For India, these shifts come at a critical juncture in its energy transition journey. The convergence of global uncertainties and domestic challenges necessitates a strategic reassessment and a multifaceted response to ensure resilience, inclusivity, and sustainable growth.

aboutEvent.mainDescription: The Regulators and Policymakers Retreat is a unique platform where regulators, policymakers, and industry leaders converge to deliberate on critical challenges and opportunities in India's power sector. It is an opportunity for participants to engage in meaningful discussions, gain actionable insights, and network with sector experts. Recognizing that the power sector does not operate in isolation, discussions will be situated within the broader context of global developments.

details.text: Date: 7th - 10th January, 2026
Time: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM daily
Location: Shoonya Farm Retreat, Belgundi Village, Belgaum District, Karnataka (Spread across 45 acres against the serene backdrop of the Western Ghats)

venue.title: About Shoonya Farm Retreat
venue.description: The Shoonya Farm Retreat was once home to Indian freedom fighter and industrialist Dr. A.G. Tendulkar. He had strong relationships with leaders like Mahatma Gandhi and Sardar Vallabhai Patel and returned to India after years abroad to contribute to the freedom struggle and, subsequently, to Indian industries. In addition to being a Gandhian, he was also an advocate for industrialisation post-independence and an early naturalist. We at IPPAI seek to offer the participants a pleasant pause from the daily hum drum, creating an opportunity to think afresh about how to approach various policy issues crucial to the Power Sector and the country.

items.title: DAY 1: Geopolitics & Energy Security
items.description: The Retreat will examine the impact of recent geopolitical developments on global energy markets—particularly their implications for energy security, supply chains, and pricing in the Indian context.

items.title: DAY 2: Climate Change & Sustainability
items.description: Participants will explore how climate change is shaping India's energy future. Key discussions will cover the Water-Food-Energy Nexus, the role of hydropower, the potential of pumped storage, and the interlinkages with irrigation.

items.title: DAY 3: Power Markets & Regulation
items.description: The Retreat will consider the need to strike the right balance between regulation and open markets, fostering an investment-friendly environment while safeguarding consumer interests—including Market Coupling, Electricity Derivatives, and Virtual Power Purchase Agreements (VPPAs).

items.title: DAY 4: Critical Issues in Indian Power Sector
items.description: Granular analysis of key issues including Transmission Planning, RE Must-Run vs Congestion, Demand Forecasting, BESS, Open Access, GNA, DISCOM Profitability, Green Hydrogen, SMRs, and Role of AI & ML in Power Sector.

Emerging Technologies: Role of AI & ML in the Power Sector

whyAttend.title: Why you should be there
whyAttend.description: JOIN THE CONVERSATION THAT SHAPES INDIA'S ENERGY FUTURE. This retreat offers a unique opportunity for high-level policy dialogue in an intimate setting away from the usual conference environment. A major challenge within this transition is the integration of renewable energy into the national grid. As India rapidly scales up solar and wind power, the grid must evolve to manage variability, ensure stability, and balance supply-demand in real time.

Be part of shaping India's energy future through strategic policy discussions and collaborative problem-solving.

breadcrumb.eventTitle: 103- Advanced Energy Economics and Market Design

events.fullDescription: Master the complexities of energy economics with this intensive three-day workshop covering market design, pricing mechanisms, and economic modeling in modern energy systems.

aboutEvent.mainDescription: Dive deep into energy economics with IPPAI's most comprehensive workshop yet! This intensive program is designed for economists, analysts, and professionals who need to understand and work with complex energy market mechanisms and pricing strategies.

details.text: Date: Monday-Wednesday, January 20-22, 2026.

Location: Energy Economics Institute (Inside Mumbai International Finance Centre)

items.title: Market Design Principles:
items.description: Understand the fundamental principles of energy market design, including auction mechanisms, capacity markets, and ancillary services.

items.description: Learn advanced pricing models including nodal pricing, time-of-use rates, and dynamic pricing mechanisms for modern energy markets.

items.title: Economic Modeling:
items.description: Hands-on sessions with industry-standard economic modeling tools and techniques for energy market analysis and forecasting.

items.title: Global Case Studies:

whyAttend.title: Why you should be there:
whyAttend.description: This intensive workshop provides the analytical tools and market insights essential for anyone working in energy economics, market analysis, or energy finance. You'll leave with practical skills and a comprehensive understanding of how energy markets function and evolve.

prizes.title: Exciting Prizes (Attendees Only!):
items: 1 Full scholarship to advanced energy economics certification program worth $10,000!
Professional software licenses worth INR 50,000 for energy modeling and analysis tools!
Exclusive invitation to IPPAI's annual Energy Economics Summit with leading global experts.

events.conclusion: Join us for this transformative learning experience that will enhance your expertise in energy economics and market analysis. Whether you're shaping policy, developing market strategies, or conducting research, this workshop will provide the advanced knowledge you need to excel in the energy sector.
